experiment: ORION Phase 11.4 ESA log-risk prediction-bias and feature diagnostics

feature_order_and_units.live_adapter_conversion: Stage 2A km and km/s values are multiplied by 1000 to SI m and m/s; live relative states are projected onto instantaneous primary RTN at TCA
feature_order_and_units.reader_conversion: raw numeric CSV values are assigned directly in declared FEATURE_NAMES order; no conversion is applied in training reader
feature_order_and_units.unit_interpretation: dataset feature units follow project metadata/model-card contract; the raw ESA archive columns do not encode units in their header

findings.feature_distribution_shift: per-feature range and quantile summaries are supplied for event-level scoring rows and training fit rows; differences describe this single split and may reflect mission composition or different row-selection populations, not causal drivers.
findings.high_risk_underprediction: supported: for high-risk label subsets, mean and median signed errors are negative in held-out validation/test; see exact supports and metrics in error_analysis. Fixed threshold detects none because no predictions reach -6.
findings.mission_dependence: per-mission errors differ; mission 14 has only 10 test events and 3 high-risk labels; validation has only missions 9 and 13, with unequal event counts. No broad mission-level inference is supported.
findings.prediction_compression: supported: both regressors have prediction distributions much narrower than observed target tails, with maxima below -6 in every split; training predictions are in-sample. On held-out data, HGB max -9.32 (test) and Ridge max -17.55 (test), versus observed max -1.68.
findings.preprocessing_or_schema_defect: none confirmed: ordered names align, training fit is training-only, missingness is counted, and no training conversion is done beyond direct parsing. Unit semantics remain dependent on dataset/project documentation; live adapter does explicit km-to-SI conversion and RTN projection.
findings.risk_band_error_changes: summarized by observed target bands in error_analysis; small high-risk strata limit interpretation, especially 10 validation positives.

limitations: ESA risk label predictions are not Foster Pc or calibrated probabilities.
Training metric/prediction summaries are in-sample and optimistic.
Validation/test results come from one mission-grouped split and the curated challenge dataset.
No operational or independent real-world risk reference corpus is available.

preprocessing_assessment.imputation: median SimpleImputer plus missing indicators fitted on training eligible rows only
preprocessing_assessment.limitations: Numerical values and code ordering were checked, but archive header labels do not independently prove physical units; live-vs-historical semantic equivalence is not established.
preprocessing_assessment.ridge_scaling: StandardScaler fitted on imputed training rows only

protocol.fixed_prediction_threshold: predicted ESA log-risk >= -6.0; not a Pc threshold

model_parameters.preprocessing: median imputer with missingness indicators fit on training eligible rows; Ridge additionally StandardScaler fit on training only
model_parameters.training_weights: each training event total weight 1 across its eligible rows

protocol.prediction_error: prediction minus observed ESA log-risk; negative means underprediction
protocol.split_algorithm: sorted unique mission IDs; random.Random(42).shuffle; floor 70%, floor 15%, remainder test
protocol.training_fit_rows: all eligible pre-final rows from training missions, event-balanced sample weights
protocol.training_predictions: in-sample on one selected row per training event; descriptive only
protocol.validation_test_rows: closest-to-TCA eligible pre-final row per event

unresolved_hypotheses: Squared-error regression with a target mass concentrated at -30 may shrink predictions toward the bulk; this is plausible but not causally established by these diagnostics.
The raw ESA archive feature columns are unitless in their headers; project metadata asserts SI units, but no independent source convention was validated in this phase.
Historical ESA CDM feature semantics may differ from live TLE-derived feature semantics; this experiment cannot resolve live domain equivalence.
Mission generalization estimates remain uncertain with only two validation missions and four test missions.
